entities.name: Babad Tanah Jawi
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: Babad Tanah Jawi, is a generic title for many manuscripts written in the Javanese language. Their arrangements and details vary, and no copies of any of the manuscripts are older than the 18th century.
